product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic is an AI-powered, low-code integration platform that helps enterprise IT and business teams connect applications, data, APIs and AI agents and automate workflows.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts describe the engineering team’s GitOps-based ephemeral development environments and its internal LLM-powered testing architecture; authors are Nilay Narlawar and Ashok Pallamala.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applied AI Architect; fractional contract engagement, not a full-time position.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Google Gemini; Amazon Bedrock is also a supported access platform.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims, not independently verified certificates: the security page explicitly identifies SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA-HITECH certification and GDPR compliance. The financial-institution resource expressly claims ISO 27001 and PCI DSS as well; the general security page describes ISO 27001 in connection with AWS infrastructure.

last_funding.notes: Latest dated financing record found: completed general debt financing on 2025-08-13; amount undisclosed. PitchBook also lists an undated secondary transaction, which cannot be chronologically ranked and is not necessarily capital raised by the company. Latest publicly announced amount-bearing equity round was $165 million in December 2021, classified as Series H by PitchBook and CB Insights.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook records completed debt financing on 2025-08-13, within 2025-05-09–2026-11-09. This is a dated financing-database record, not a company announcement or regulatory filing; no corresponding primary announcement was located. No newer announced equity round was found.

launched_6mo.notes: 2026-10-20: major platform expansion including natural-language agent workflow creation, prebuilt agentic-tool patterns, expanded MCP capabilities and Amazon Bedrock RAG support.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated executive-movement notice posted 2026-09-22 reports that CFO Ahsan Malik left the company; this is the notice date rather than a separately established departure date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The account-executive posting requires Salesforce opportunity/activity management; the marketing-operations posting names Marketo and Salesforce as its marketing stack. These indicate internal usage rather than merely connector availability.
